newsitem.title: USA: First Republic changes name to Republic First.
newsitem.headline: First Republic changes name to Republic First.

text.p: First Republic Bancorp Inc, parent company of First Republic Bank, said Tuesday it changed its name to Republic First Bancorp Inc.
The company said the change was made to avoid possible confusion with First Republic Bancorp of California, which is not affiliated with the Philadelphia-based company.
Republic First's ticker symbol on the Nasdaq market (FRBK) will remain the same and the subsidiary bank will continue to use the name First Republic Bank, it said.
